caption: Great Meteoron, Kalambaka
composition: Large monastery complex on a broad rock · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the path below, the Great Meteoron covers the top of a broad sandstone rock with many red-roofed buildings and a church among them, and a stone stair climbs the face. It is one large complex, not the needle rock of Rousanou and not the wide valley group of GR-01-006. The sky is clear, about 11.0°C, with wind near 6 km/h. Morning sun comes from the east-southeast, and the rock is not floodlit.
